label: LTX Layout to Render
description: LTX-2.5 Layout to Render IC-LoRA: turns a clay / playblast layout clip into a finished shot, following its camera and movement and taking the look from an art-directed first frame (and optional mid and last frames). Output: an EXR sequence in ACES2065-1 at the layout's size and frame numbers, no audio.
usage: Turns a layout clip (clay viewport, blocky playblast) into a finished shot (LTX-2.5 Layout to Render, two stages).
Connect the layout clip to 'layout': it sets the camera and the movement. Whole input range is sent; tick 'input range' to send only first-last.
Connect the art-directed first frame to 'first' (required): the layout's first frame made into the finished look with any image model. Don't use the grey clay frame itself.
Only one frame of 'first' is sent: the layout's first frame, or the still itself if it is a single image.

Optional 'mid' and 'last': art-directed stills that hold the look through the shot. 'last' is placed on the last frame sent, 'mid' at 'mid frame' (0 = the middle). Each sends the frame at its place, or the still itself.
prompt: one or two sentences describing the finished shot, matching the look. Don't write 'clay', '3D' or 'Unreal'.
It renders at 544 px short side, then 2x (1088). 'output size' = layout size scales it back to line up with the layout; a 4K layout comes back soft.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) compresses values above 1 going in: highlights return approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed and new near-whites come back hot. 'clip' cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open.
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.

License (checked 2026-11): LTX-2.x Community - commercial use is free under $10M annual revenue (affiliates count); above that needs a paid license. Generated content must be disclosed as machine-generated when distributed.

refs.name: first
refs.required: the art-directed first frame that sets the look

output.tooltip: LTX works on display-referred images, so highlights are rolled off or clipped (see the highlights knob).

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: One or two sentences describing the finished shot, matching the 'first' still. Don't write 'clay', '3D' or 'Unreal'.

knobs.name: mid_frame
knobs.label: mid frame
knobs.tooltip: Where the 'mid' still is placed: a frame number of the layout. 0 = the middle of the frames sent. Only used when 'mid' is connected.

knobs.name: output_size
knobs.label: output size
knobs.tooltip: layout size (default): scaled back to the layout clip's size, so it lines up. keep upscale: the model's own size, 1088 px on the short side.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: roll off (default): the layout and stills go in through ACES Output - sRGB and the result comes back through its inverse, so highlights are compressed instead of cut. Highlights come back approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed, and new near-white pixels come back hot (display 0.98 = about 7, 1.0 = about 16). clip: values above 1 reach the model as 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open.
